items.name: Heat Sink
items.description: A disposable thermal buffer. Use it to dump half of your trace alert instantly.

items.name: Cipher Lens
items.description: A pattern-recognition lens. Cipher puzzles hand you a free hint.

items.name: Trace Booster
items.description: Raises the efficiency of every trace probe. Data streams run slower.

items.name: Route Amplifier
items.description: Widens the relay budget in routing puzzles.

items.name: Stealth Cloak
items.description: Your mistakes raise the trace alert 15% less.

items.name: Firewall Analyzer
items.description: Improves every firewall mini-game: more attempts and better feedback.

items.name: Trace Module MK.II
items.description: Second-generation stream analyser with a built-in relay scanner.

items.name: Mesh Antenna
items.description: A distributed antenna that bounces your signal through quiet corners.

items.name: Learning Matrix
items.description: Analyses every operation you run and feeds the lessons back: +10% XP.

items.name: Credit Siphon
items.description: Skims a legal-ish 10% off every payout.

items.name: Quantum Decryptor
items.description: Brute-forces entangled ciphers. Required for the hardest decryption missions.

items.name: Firewall Prism
items.description: Splits a firewall into its component rules and shows you the weak ones.

items.name: Overclock Chip
items.description: Runs your whole rig hot. A little of everything.

items.name: Trace Array MK.III
items.description: A full sensor array. Trace streams crawl.

items.name: Ghost Router
items.description: A router that officially does not exist.

items.name: Oracle Core
items.description: A predictive engine that has already read the plaintext.

items.name: NEXUS Core
items.description: A shard of the NEXUS kernel itself. Endgame. Also opens the final secret operation.

items.name: Ghost Token
items.short: Unlocks the SPECTER secret mission series
items.description: A token that exists in no ledger. Opens a hidden chain of operations on SHADOW.

message.text: A token like that is rare, {player}. Find me on SHADOW. Bring nerves.

items.name: Black Key
items.description: A key for a door that is not on any map.

items.name: Operator License
items.description: Official clearance for high-risk contract work.

items.name: Grid Survey
items.short: Reveals four hosts on the network map
items.description: A broker's survey of the outer grid.

lines: Four new hosts appear on your map.

items.name: Vault Codes
items.short: Reveals more hosts and a secret rumour
items.description: Leaked access notes for mid-tier hosts.

lines: Three more hosts appear on your map.

items.name: ZERO Dossier
items.short: A tracked history of user ID 000
items.description: Everything GHOST could scrape about ZERO.

message.text: Page 3 of the dossier is a lie. Page 7 isn't. That's all I'll say.

lines: The dossier suggests ZERO logs in from inside NEXUS. It mentions a file named /.first_log on ORCHID.

items.name: Deep Survey
items.description: Survey data for the industrial and military grid.

lines: Four deep-grid hosts appear on your map.

items.name: Theme: CLASSIC GREEN
items.description: The terminal colour scheme of a thousand late nights.

items.name: Theme: CYAN
items.description: A cool, clinical palette.

items.name: Theme: AMBER
items.description: A vintage amber monitor.

items.name: Theme: PURPLE
items.description: Synthwave nights.

items.name: Theme: RED ALERT
items.description: Everything is on fire. Stylishly.

items.name: Theme: NEXUS
items.description: The interface of the core itself. Also unlocked by finishing the campaign.
